_heir: The envelope goes to the primary heir and nobody else, on every channel they have an address for. It is the PDF from 'Passphrase in a text': worthless without the password database, so it is stored and sent as it is.
_lang: The heir and each confirmer can have their own language (en, sk, cs); the default is en.
_signal: An optional second channel. Leave out the whole `signal` block and every signal number and everything goes by e-mail alone.
_options: confirm_quorum = how many distinct confirmers are needed (default 1). Increment checkin_key_version if the check-in link leaks. smtp_timeout bounds the whole SMTP conversation.
